text:
Hana Park: Quick sync thread to lock GA handoff for Inference Gateway v1. Target date Dec 8. Need final agreement on SLAs, pricing SKUs, monitoring alerts, oncall rota, and which docs go public at GA.

Liam O'Connor: Proposed SLAs for GA: Hosted Tier-A 99.96% monthly uptime, Dedicated 99.985%. Latency SLOs: embeddings p95 <= 40ms, small-gen p95 <= 110ms. Publish p50/p95 cold-start numbers in docs only.

Sofia Ruiz: Add error SLO: 5xx rate < 0.08% (1h rolling). Also call out fallback order in public docs: primary model -> same-region quantized variant -> secondary-region equivalent -> customer safe-mode. I'll draft the fallback table.

Hana Park: Good. Pricing: we keep 3 SKUs (dev, standard, enterprise). Dev: free tier with 10k tokens/mo. Standard: pay-as-you-go + soft QPS 140, burst to 420 for 30s. Enterprise: reserved throughput + contractual SLA and 4h ack. docs-bot, can you prep sample invoices?

docs-bot: Staged pricing page created: https://docs.redwood.com/staging/igw-ga-pricing. Included sample calc rows for 100k/1M tokens. Will update when QPS numbers final.

Liam O'Connor: Monitoring alerts to include in GA runbook: sustained p95 breach > 6m, error-rate spike >0.4% over 5m, GPU util >92% for 10m, cache-hit rate drop >20% 10m. Each alert must link to runbook mitigation and PagerDuty escalation.

Sofia Ruiz: Oncall: enterprise customers require 24/7 primary with 4h ticket ack. Ops prefers a 7-day rotation with two engineers on call (primary + secondary). infra-bot, can you create the rota stub and PD schedule?

infra-bot: Created calendar "IGW GA oncall" and PagerDuty schedule "IGW-GA-enterprise"; provisional rota: Liam, Sofia, Hana, +1. Runbook page published at /runbooks/igw-ga. Smoke window scheduled Dec 7 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Hana Park: Docs split: internal release notes + runbook by Thu EOD, public docs (FAQ + pricing + limitations) Thu night after pricing lock. Sofia will own fallback + runbook, Liam will own SLA doc + dashboards, docs-bot will publish public pages.

Liam O'Connor: I'll push the SLA PR and dashboard snapshots today. Expect PR link by 5pm PT.

Sofia Ruiz: I'll open the fallback/runbook PR with decision table and mitigation steps. ETA Wed morning.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Pricing staging live; will promote after SLA PR merges.

Hana Park: Outstanding checklist (owners):
- Final SLA numbers & public SLA page -> Liam
- Error-rate SLO + fallback decision table -> Sofia
- Pricing SKUs + examples -> docs-bot + Hana (commercial review)
- Runbook + PD rota -> Sofia + infra-bot
- Monitoring alerts wired to dashboards + PD -> Liam
- AE cheat-sheet + limitations blurb -> Hana

Liam O'Connor: One open question: do we advertise a cold-start mitigation guide (best practices) in the public FAQ? I think yes.

Sofia Ruiz: Yes please 1: put a short section with warmup tips and suggested batch sizes. Not an SLA, but helps customers.

Hana Park: Agreed. We'll include a "How to reduce cold starts" note in the FAQ.

infra-bot: Reminder: runbook review scheduled Wed 10:00 PT. Automated smoketests will post results after Dec 7 window.

Hana Park: Please react with :white_check_mark: when your items are green so I can consolidate signoffs. If any blockers, call them out in this thread before Wed review. Thanks!
